timeline.text: Hi Rahul, I am an AI assistant calling from Greenleaf Residences. This call is recorded. Is this a good time to talk?
Yeah, sure, but make it quick.
Thanks! Are you looking for a two or three BHK home at Greenleaf Residences?
I'm looking for a 2BHK. What's the starting price?
Prices for a 2BHK start at ₹1.12 crore. What is your budget and when are you planning to buy?
My budget is around a crore, looking to move in within 3 months.
Got it. Would you like to know the current availability for 2BHK units?
Not really. Can we just book a site visit for this Saturday morning?
Shuru karne se pehle, kya main site visit Saturday morning ke liye book karne ki consent record kar sakti hoon?
Yes, absolutely, please book it for Saturday morning.
Aapka site visit Saturday 10:30 AM ke liye book ho gaya hai. Main brochure WhatsApp par bhej doon?
Brochure WhatsApp par bhej diya hai. Kuch aur jaanna hai?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help. Bye!
Thank you for your time, Rahul. Have a great day!
